method.unit: CSV rows; cross-architecture section uses unique row_uid values
method.normalization: Replace literal backslash-n with spaces, then collapse whitespace
method.limitation: A matching filename and identity identify an available candidate packet. Final CSVs do not bind each historical model call to an immutable packet hash; resolution_date is not present in those CSVs. Neither filename nor semantic matches prove which packet was actually consumed or historical availability of source content. ID-only matches are weaker.

cache.manifest_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), no newline

cross_architecture_unique_row_uid.duplicate_uid_handling: Every A/B row with a shared UID must satisfy the condition; no keep-first join
